serverInfo.name: @guardbee/mcp-db-gateway
serverInfo.description: KVKK/GDPR-compliant MCP gateway between LLMs and databases. Provides PII masking, RBAC, rate limiting, and audit logging.

tools.name: query_table
tools.description: Query rows from a database table. PII fields are automatically masked according to configured field rules.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List all accessible database tables. Role-based access restrictions are applied.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Show table schema and the active masking policy for each field.

tools.name: gateway_status
tools.description: Show active configuration: role, rate limit status, field rules, and table rules.
